acceptanceCriteria: Reproduce under load (for example go test ./internal/tasks/store/ -count=1 while cmd/corvint tests run) or show the three tests are deadline-bound and widen or make their deadlines load-aware
Decide with ticket:corvint:main:V1-1294 whether one fix covers the class; record the outcome in a build-log entry
Record in the test file why each injected timing point is reached only on a quiet host, or remove the assumption
body: Suspected flake, not a confirmed defect. During the V1-1278 S1 lane (PR beamfall/corvint#850, branch claude/v1-1278-s1-core at 4388165e, go1.27.1) a focused run of ./internal/tasks/store/... alongside cmd/corvint, tools and conformance packages took 1671.8s and failed three tests: TestPSRSweepMismatchRetries (pool_sweep_test.go:143 injected retry not reached), TestPSRAmbiguousResponseReconciliation/finish-response (pool_sweep_test.go:245 response injection before durable confirm) and TestCALV0089_ProgramWallExpiryEndsContinuation (program_continuation_test.go:664 program wall error native transition refused, outcome BLOCKED codes LIMIT_EXCEEDED, detail shared program turn/wall cap). The builder reran the package separately and it passed. The orchestrator reproduced at origin/main 4e609405e on 2026-10-12 with GOTOOLCHAIN=local go test -count=1 -timeout 30m ./internal/tasks/store/ on a quiet host: ok in 62.9s. The S1 change touches no internal/tasks path. Evidence: scratchpad agent-1278/focused.log lines 19-27 and store-tests-main.log. Related: ticket:corvint:main:V1-1294 (TestCALV0188_GroupListingOverrun under host load); same class, wall-clock deadlines in store tests that assume a quiet host.
title: internal/tasks/store: three timing tests fail under host load (PSRSweepMismatchRetries, PSRAmbiguousResponseReconciliation, CALV0089_ProgramWallExpiryEndsContinuation)
